introduction: Victor is an unknown clerk in the company. Day after day, he feels tired of his work and finds himself being insociable. He can only ease himself and free himself from the repeated life by eating chocolate. At the beginning, Victor tries to control himself from relying on chocolate, but things only go on the opposite way. Gradually, he can not concentrate on his work without chocolate. Moreover, he starts hallucinating and being expelled by colleagues. The negative blow makes him more unable to control his desire for chocolate. Eventually he is completely eroded by the satisfaction with eating chocolate.
